title: Oi Oi Oi
blurb: Football-terrace energy compressed into roughly two seconds. What makes this chant so efficient is that it is call-and-response by design — say it once and somebody in the room will answer without deciding to, which converts a collection of individuals into a crowd almost instantly. That is a genuinely useful property at parties, in Discord calls, and anywhere collective enthusiasm needs igniting from cold. It carries no information whatsoever and works on everybody. The internet's most reliable hype primer, and considerably older than the internet itself.
